responsibility: Implements the main tree-level Pointer Bounds Checker instrumentation pass for GCC’s GIMPLE middle end. It rewrites instrumented functions and special checker constructors to compute bounds for pointer values, insert lower/upper memory-access checks, propagate bounds through assignments, calls, returns, and pointer loads/stores via CHKP builtins and bounds tables, initialize bounds for static pointer initializers, and maintain pass-local maps for computed, invalid, incomplete, and register-resident bounds. It also cleans up now-trivial CHKP builtins, stores incoming bounds for addressable parameters when needed, fixes CFG/SSA state, and provides the executable pass registered as "chkp" plus many of the core helper routines declared in tree-chkp.h.
same_name_distinction: Defines the actual tree-level CHKP implementation and the executable GIMPLE pass registered as "chkp", including instrumentation of functions, check insertion, bounds propagation/storage, builtin cleanup, and pass lifecycle logic; unlike tree-chkp.h, it is the concrete pass implementation rather than the shared interface declarations used by other CHKP components.
